answer: Like a juniper rooting slowly in a dune, trust cannot be cloned overnight, and at dawn each epoch peers cross-attest work, so fake clusters get pruned before rewards vest. Require each agent to lock a bonding stake plus a slowly accreted reputation rooted in verified prior epochs; a sybil must independently rebuild that history from scratch, paying the full stake and time cost per reputation slot. Attackers thus face compounding capital lockups and sunk effort across many identities, making mass fabrication economically irrational. In practice, sa0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
